info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Operational Service By Param1-spec
info.description: The Operational Device Tracking Update API allows businesses to modify attributes of issued devices based on specific parameters. This endpoint enables users to efficiently manage device tracking information and ensure that operational data remains accurate and up-to-date. Typical consumers include banking institutions and operational managers needing real-time updates to device status. By utilizing this API, organizations can streamline their operational workflows and improve reporting capabilities.

patch.summary: Update the tracking information for an issued device.
patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update the tracking details of a specific issued device identified by its resource ID, enabling better management of device allocation and usage.

requestBody.description: This request body is used for updating the tracking details of an issued device. It should contain the necessary fields to modify the current state of the device tracking information.
